# Pertemuan 2
```{r}
library(readxl)

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# 1. Baca data Excel
data.hp <- read_excel("Data Handpone.xlsx")
str(data.hp)
```

```{r}
head(data.hp)
```


# Pertemuan 3


```{r} 
str(data.hp)
harga.hp <- data.hp$harga # Diubah dari $hargahp ke $harga
length(harga.hp)
head(harga.hp)
library(stringr)
#remove dot
h1 <- str_remove_all(harga.hp,"[.]")
#ekstrak angka
h2 <- str_extract(h1,"[0-9]+")
#dibuat format numerik
h3 <- as.numeric(h2) #sudah ok
head(h3)
```

```{r}
##ekstraksi peubah
#ekstraksi nama merek HP
nama.hp <- data.hp$nama_produk # Diubah dari $namahp ke $nama_produk
head(nama.hp)
#identifikasi list nama HP
list.hp1 <- str_extract(nama.hp, '[A-Za-z]+')
hp2 <- as.factor(list.hp1)
summary(hp2)
list.hp2 <- str_extract(nama.hp, '\\b(?!SMARTPHONE\\b)\\w+\\b')
hp3 <- as.factor(list.hp2)
summary(hp3)
list.hp3 <- str_extract(nama.hp, '\\b(?!SMARTPHONE\\b|[Hh][Pp]\\b)\\w+\\b')
hp4 <- as.factor(list.hp3)
summary(hp4)
```


# Pertemuan 4

```{r}
##visualisasi
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(data = data.frame(x = h3),
aes(x = x)) +
 geom_histogram(aes(y = ..density..),
fill = "lightblue", color = "black") +
 geom_density(alpha = 0.5, fill =
"red") +
 labs(title = "Price Histogram with
Density Curve", x = "Value", y =
"Density") +
 theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
##visualisasi nama
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
# Categorical data
dt.nama <- data.frame(
 Category = merk_hp)
# Summarize the data
summarized_data <- dt.nama %>%
 group_by(Category) %>%
 summarise(Value = n())
# Create a beautiful bar chart using ggplot2
ggplot(summarized_data, aes(x = Value, y = Category, fill = Category)) +
 geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black") + # Bar chart with border
 scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set3") + # Color palette from RColorBrewer
 theme_minimal() + # Minimal theme for a clean look
 labs(title = "Horizontal Bar Chart of Category Counts", x = "Count", y = "Category") +
 theme(
 plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16, face = "bold"),
 axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
 axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
 axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
 axis.text.y = element_text(size = 5),
 legend.position = "none" # Hide legend if not needed
 )
```
